samples.xml_description:
<module id="barrel_shifter">
    <description>A barrel shifter for rotating bits efficiently. This 8-bit barrel shifter takes an 8-bit input and shifts or rotates the bits based on a 3-bit control signal.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="in" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input to be shifted.</input>
        <input id="ctrl" width_description="[2:0]">A 3-bit control signal indicating the number of positions to shift.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit shifted output.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Implements a 8-bit barrel shifter with three stages of mux2X1s.</implementation>
</module>
